Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 32 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Hema - 56 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Shalini - 26 years, friend
Look: green saree
4. Anita - 26 years, daughter
Look: green saree
5. Suresh - 36 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Karan stands in the office. Anita stands near him.]

Karan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Karan sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Karan (softly): "What next?"

[Karan stretches after hours at the computer.]

Karan (gently): "What happened?"

[Karan presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Anita: "That was such a fun day!"
